status_legend.approved: Stated by the lab (user request) or approved in the Rules editor. Enforced at its severity.
status_legend.pending: Copied from an attached lab document, waiting for approval. Checked, but every finding notes that the rule is pending.
status_legend.literature: Taken from a published Methods section for a group template. Checked like 'pending' until the lab approves it.
status_legend.missing: No value supplied yet. The app asks for it the first time a check needs it; it is never guessed.

ebl.electrode_width_target_um.description: Design target: every electrode / lead at least this wide. Below it (but above the hard minimum) is a warning.

source.quote: at least 0.8um wide for each electrodes

ebl.electrode_spacing_target_um.description: Design target: spacing between Hall-bar arms and between electrodes.

source.quote: try to keep at least 0.8um spacing bettern hall bars

ebl.contact_width_min_um.description: Hard minimum electrode width (liftoff, optical visibility).

source.quote: Contact width > 0.5 um

ebl.contact_spacing_min_um.description: Hard minimum gap between neighbouring contacts / leads.

source.quote: Keep 0.4 um between contacts.

ebl.arm_spacing_min_um.description: Minimum distance between graphene contact arms (device etch).

source.quote: Distance between graphene contact arms > 0.3 um.

ebl.corner_radius_min_um.description: Round etch-mask corners at least this much (PMMA cracks / backscattering).

source.quote: Round corners (radius > 0.05 um) to avoid PMMA cracks.

ebl.contact_to_graphite_gate_min_um.description: Minimum distance from a 1D contact to a graphite BG / TG.

source.quote: Contact - BG distance > 0.7 um (same for distance from graphite TG/BG)

ebl.device_etch_beyond_bg_um.description: For 1D edge contacts the etched Hall-bar arms extend this far beyond the back gate.

source.quote: Extend ~1.5 um beyond BG for 1D contacts (otherwise 1D contacts will short BG to graphene)

ebl.metal_tg_width_min_um.description: Minimum width of a metal top gate.

source.quote: Metal TG > 0.4 um wide

ebl.defect_clearance_um.description: How far the channel and arms must stay from marked defects (wrinkles, thick steps, bubbles).

source.quote: avoid defect regions (wrinkle, thick step, bubbles)

ebl.contact_overlap_um.description: How far a 1D-contact electrode overlaps the end of its etched arm.

ebl.alignment_region_um.description: Size of the alignment region around a device.

source.quote: 800x800 um alignment region is good for all practical reasons.

ebl.etch_mask_overhang_um.description: How far an etch mask (Hall-bar etch, board etch) reaches beyond the flake edge it must clear.

ebl.board_etch_keep_margin_um.description: Margin of the region kept by the board etch around the graphene device layer (the kept area must be larger than the graphene).

source.quote: the board etch of graphene device should preserve an area that's larger than graphene device layer area (margin not given)

ebl.etch_window_size_um.description: Side of the square top-BN-only windows used to check the board / contact etch.

source.quote: Protect two windows for a top-BN-only region. (size not given)

stack.substrate_breakdown_field_MV_per_c.description: Breakdown field of the substrate SiO2, used with the planned maximum Si back-gate voltage.

source.quote: dielectric breakdown strength for substrate

stack.hbn_breakdown_field_MV_per_cm.description: Optional: hBN breakdown field, used with each gate's planned maximum voltage. Not asked for unless a gate has a maximum voltage.

stack.board_etch_keep_contains_device.description: The region kept by the board etch must contain the whole device (graphene) layer and be larger than it.

source.quote: the board etch of graphene device should preserve an area that's larger than graphene device layer area

stack.alignment_shift_um.description: Lateral misalignment to allow between flakes during stacking (transfer). The flake list adds it on every side of each flake's design size.

xu.middle_hbn_edge_margin_um.description: The thin middle hBN (contact-gate dielectric) must extend at least this far beyond every TMD edge, so contact gates sit on hBN and never touch the TMD.

source.quote: middle BN edge should be at least 1um away from the WSe2 edges to allow contact gates

xu.bottom_hbn_larger.description: Bottom hBN larger than the middle hBN and the TMD.

source.quote: requires a larger bottom BN

xu.middle_hbn_max_thickness_nm.description: Upper limit for the 'thin' middle hBN (contact-gate dielectric).

source.quote: thin middle BN (no number given)

gr.bottom_bn_larger_than_bg_three_sides.description: Bottom BN larger than the back gate on three sides; the BG sticks out on the fourth for its contact.

source.quote: Bottom BN should be larger than the back gate in 3 directions and the BG should stick out on the 4th direction

gr.graphene_bg_overlap_needs_bottom_bn.description: Wherever graphene overlaps the BG there must be bottom BN.

source.quote: Any overlap between graphene and BG requires bottom BN there.

gr.graphene_tg_overlap_needs_top_bn.description: Wherever graphene overlaps the TG there must be top BN.

source.quote: Any overlap between graphene and TG requires top BN there.

gr.tg_extends_beyond_graphene.description: A metal TG crosses the whole channel and extends outside the graphene.

source.quote: TGs should extend outside graphene to avoid shorting of TG to graphene by the TG contact arm

gr.contacts_outside_bg_for_1d.description: 1D contacts are placed outside the back gate.

source.quote: 1D contacts should be outside BG.

gr.contact_metal_thicker_than_stack.description: The 1D-contact metal is thicker than the etched BN/graphene/BN step it climbs.

source.quote: Cr/Au: 5nm/~60nm (thicker than BN/Gr/BN)

gr.board_etch_windows.description: The board etch includes top-BN-only windows to check the etch.

source.quote: Protect two windows for a top-BN-only region.

mak.tg_smaller_than_bg.description: The top gate is smaller than the bottom gate and defines the channel; split gates deplete the BG-only regions.

source.doc: Y. Xia et al., Nature 637, 833 (2025), arXiv:2405.14784, Methods
source.quote: The top gate is smaller in area and defines the device channel

etch.bn_rate_nm_per_s.description: Oxford RIE recipe 'BN - Test' etch rate (rises with time; see Fab Manual).

source.quote: Recipe “BN – Test”, rate: ~1.5 nm / 10 s.
rate: ~2 nm / 1 s.

etch.board_overetch_nm.description: Board etch: etch this much more than top BN + bottom BN.

source.quote: Usually etch 5-10 nm more than the total thickness of top BN and bottom BN.

etch.contact_bottom_bn_nm.description: 1D contacts: after top BN and graphene, etch this much of the bottom BN.

source.quote: Recipe “BN – Test”, etch 5-10 nm bottom BN.
Cr (pocket 5) ... 5nm; Au (pocket 6) ... ~60nm
Deposition: Ti/Au: 5nm/70nm

source.section: Graphene Devices - New, 2a. Metallic top gate
source.quote: Deposition: Ti/Au: 5nm/30nm

microscope.um_per_px.description: Image scale per objective for the stacking / inspection camera. Stage 2 calibrates the 100x scale from the alignment markers; Stage 1 flake images need this (or a scale entered per image).

design.thickness_nm.description: Lab design thickness (nm) for a 2D layer, per 'material:function' (e.g. 'hBN:top_gate_dielectric'). Used by Configure for layers whose thickness is empty. Asked for the first time it is needed.

design.metal_nm.description: Lab design thickness (nm) of each metal in a deposited stack, per 'material:function:metal' (e.g. 'Ti/PdAu:bottom_gate:Ti'). Used by Configure when no Fab Manual default matches. Asked for the first time it is needed.

_note: TEST SEED: the lab configuration as seeded (before any value was entered in UStack). Tests copy this, never config/.
